resume: Ambience machine for DJ interludes: when switched on, a random world in key is already playing. Four parts (pulse, floor, haze, voice), buttons that are verbs, and the worlds you like breed new ones.

commandes.role: Rotates the key around the circle of fifths.
Rotates the key around the circle of fifths.
Verb SCL, cascade: more notes, higher, a third above.
Verb SCRAMBLE: the rhythm and the phrase break apart.
Held: a new world, random or derived from one of your favorites.
Root, scale and register; a press advances the scale.
DRIFT switch: values drift on their own; held, sets RATE, RANGE and REACH.
Short press: keeps the current world as a favorite (up to 16). Held about 2 s: forgets them all.
One of the three macros of the focused part.
One of the three macros of the focused part.
One of the three macros of the focused part; turning right always makes it more alive.
Play the focused part's sound. When the pulse has focus, they become a 16-step sequencer.

gestes: HOME + OCT-: settings menu (color, screen off, calibration).
Each verb: a press that rises, holds while pressed, then fades slowly; three knobs set these durations during the press.
a_savoir: KNOB 1 to 4 set the volume of parts 1 to 4 and give them focus.
Nothing is saved except favorites: every start is a new world.
